visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Extract a swap Function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The same three-line swap is written out three times. Move it into a swap function that uses pointers. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Each helper does one small job: swap exchanges two values and order calls it only when needed. The main function now reads like the algorithm: order the first pair, the second pair, then the first pair again.
